topPick.thesis: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) is trading at 16.2x P/E, a 6% discount to its sector average of 17.3x; RSI at 81 reflects strong but extended momentum — watch for potential consolidation. Three-month price momentum of +50.5% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +348% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 79/100 places MPC in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +35.4% over the past quarter.
